s: Dine hatmanat hachammin ubo y"g seipim: habba lesalleq qedera meal gabbe kira ulehatminah kede shello titztannen — asur lo lehatminah bedabar hammosip hebel apillu mibbeod yom, gezera shema yatmin beremetz, dehaynu eper shemmeorab bo gechalim, veachar kak beshabbat yishkach veyachteh baggechalim. Veim abar vehitmin apillu beshogeg — hattabshil asur, ben lo ben laacherim, ad lemotzae shabbat, im hu mitztammeq veyapeh lo, o shehaya tzonen venitchammem al yede hatmana zo. Abal im hu omed bachamimuto keshaa harishona vehu dabar shemmitztammeq vera lo — muttar, shehare eno neheneh kelal min haissur. Abal lekattechilla asur apillu hu mitztammeq vera lo. Veeno domeh lehashshehiyya shemmuttar lehashhot al gabbe kira sheenah gerupa uqetuma kol shehattabshil nitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom, lepi shessetam hatmana hi letzorek machar, shemmatminah umekassah shello titqarer ad lemachar, ulepikak tzerika yoter lechittuy kede shello yitqarer hattabshil bekol hallayla, abal setam shehiyya hi letzorek hallayla, shehare mannichah megulla, ulekak enah tzerika kol kak lechittuy kol shennitbashshela kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom, vaapillu im mashheh otah ad lemachar en lachush lechittuy, lepi sheen meat chittuy moil lah lishmor chummah ad lemachar kevan shehi megulla, abal keshehi temuna moil lah meat chittuy, laken chosheshim shemma yachteh im hi temuna beremetz, vegazeru al kol dabar hammosip hebel mishshum remetz, vaapillu im matmin letzorek hallayla, shello chalequ chakamim bigzeratam. Umittaam zeh asur lehatmin apillu basar shehu chay legamre samuk lachasheka, sheap al pi shemmuttar lehashhoto lepi shemmassiach dato mimmennu ad lemachar, ubekol hallayla yukal lehitbashshel belo chittuy, veim yukal lehitqarer achar kak ap im yachteh meat lo yoil kelum kevan shehu megulleh, abal behatmana yesh lachush shemma yachteh achar gemar bishshulo lehachaziq chummo shello yitqarer, shemmeat chittuy yoil lezeh. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheap lehatmin bedabar hammosip hebel mibbeod yom muttar kol shennitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai, o shehu chay legamre samuk lachasheka mammash, kemo shemmuttar lehashhot al gabbe kira sheenah gerupa uqetuma kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g. Ubemaqom shennahagu lehaqel al pi sebara zo — en limchot beyadam. Abal en linhog ken bishar meqomot. Veyesh meqillin od sheap im eno chay samuk lachasheka, mikkol maqom im massiach dato mimmennu ad lemachar — dino kechay legamre, umuttar lehatmino letzorek machar ap al pi shello higgia adayin lemaakal ben derusai. Veen lismok al sebara zo ella bediabad, ubilbad shello yehe ragil laasot ken:

Beshabbat atzmah asur lehatmin hachammin apillu bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, ap al pi sheeno domeh leremetz kelal. Velama aseru? Gezera shemma yimtza qedera tzonenet kesheyyabo lesalleqah mehakkira ulehatminah bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, veyishkach shehu shabbat veyartichenna al gabbe haur, veyitchayyeb mishshum mebashshel. Ulehaomerim sheen bishshul bedabar shehu mebushshal kebar ap shennitztannen achar kak, kemo sheyitbaer besimman shy"ch, chosheshin shemma yachteh baggechalim lehartichah, veyitchayyeb mishshum mabir. Abal beben hashshemashot, ap al pi shehu sapeq chasheka — muttar lehatmin bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, lepi shessetam qederot adayin rotechot hen beben hashshemashot, shessamuk leben hashshemashot maabiran meal gabbe haur, veen lachush shemma nitztannena veyartichenna:
Apillu tabshil shennitbashshel kol tzorko umitztammeq vera lo — asur lehatmin mishshechasheka, apillu bedabar sheeno mosip hebel:

Asur likpot keli al qedera rotachat lishmor chummah (im kullah temuna tachtayv), ella im ken hakkeli hu rachab, sheen dopnotayv nogeim betzidde haqqedera, sheaz en kan hatmana kelal. Abal muttar likpot keli al hattabshil kede leshomro min haakbarim, o kede shello yittannep beaprurit, lepi sheen zeh kematmin lehachem, ella keshomer venoten kissuy al haqqedera:

Ellu hem debarim hammosipim hebel, pesolet shel zetim veshel shumshemin leachar shehotziu shamnan, vezebel, umelach, vesid, vechol, ben shehem lachim ben shehem yebeshim, veteben, vezagin dehaynu pesolet shel anabim leachar shehotziu yenam, umokin (perush kol dabar rak qaruy mokin, kegon tzemer gepen utelishe tzemer rak shel behema, ugeridat begadim beluyim), vaasabim, bizman shearbatan lachim, apillu hem lachim mechamat mayim tzonenim shennapelu alehem. Abal kol mine kesut, uperot, venotzot kol haopot, uneoret shel pishtan daqqa, unesoret shel charashim, veorot, ben abudin ben sheenan abudin, vegizze tzemer — enan mosipim hebel bekol inyan:

Eper sheen gechalim meorabim bo apillu hu cham — eno mosip hebel. Veim hitmin bo qedera mibbeod yom, ubeshabbat matza bo meat gechalim boarot sabib lah o tachteha — en leesor hattabshil bediabad, meachar sheiqqar hahatmana hayeta bedabar hammuttar:

Muttar lehatmin bislaim mibbeod yom ap al pi shemmosipim hebel, lepi shehu dabar sheeno matzuy kelal sheyyatmin bislaim, mishshum shehem meshabberim haqqedera, o shemmeqalqelim hammaakal, vekol dabar sheeno matzuy kelal — lo gazeru bo chakamim. Abal dabar shellipamim tomenim bo ap sheeno matzuy kol kak — gazeru bo chakamim shello lehatmin bo im hu mosip hebel:

Taman mibbeod yom bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, venitgalla mibbeod yom, ben shennitgalla meelayv ben sheggillahu beyadayim, vehaya bedato lachazor ulekassoto mibbeod yom o mishshettechshak — asur lekassoto mishshettechshak, shehare zeh kematmin lekattechilla beshabbat, kevan shebbitchillat kenisat hashshabbat haya megulleh. Abal im haya tamun bitchillat kenisat (hashshabbat) hallayla veachar kak nitgalla — muttar lachazor ulekassoto, ben shennitgalla meelayv ben sheggillahu beyadayim, ap al pi shello haya bedato lachazor ulekassoto. Vaapillu lekatchilla yakol legalloto velachazor ulekassoto. Veken im ratza lehosip alayv beshabbat od debarim sheenam mosipim hebel — hare zeh mosip. Veken im ratza littelo kullo velatet acher bimqomo, ben sheharishon cham yoter mehashsheni, ben shehashsheni cham yoter meharishon, apillu lo haya mekusseh ella besadin — yakol littol hassadin ulekassoto biglupeqrin. Vehu shennitbashshela haqqedera kol tzorkah, abal im enah mebushshelet kol tzorkah vehi temuna al gabbe hakkira (sheyyesh bah gechalim) al derek sheyyitbaer — asur apillu lehosip al hakkissuy, shettosepet zeh gorem lemaher habbishshul mehaggechalim:

Lo aseru lehatmin beshabbat bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, ella keshemmatmin beotah qedera atzmah shennitbashshel bah hattabshil, sheaz yesh ligzor shemma yartichenna, abal im pinnahu liqdera acheret — muttar lehatmino. Vaapillu im chazar vehecheziro liqdera harishona — muttar lehatmino (shekkebar nitqarer qetzat bedopne qedera hashsheniyya, vachakamim lo aseru ella keshehu cham bikli rishon shennitbashshel bo. Veim nitqarer qetzat ad sheen hayyad soledet bo — apillu beodo bikli rishon muttar lehatmino). Vekol shekken shemmuttar lehatmin tzonen gamur, kede shello yitztannen beyoter, o kede shettapig tzinnato. Vekol zeh bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, abal bedabar hammosip hebel asur lehatmin apillu tzonen gamur vaapillu mibbeod yom:

Quppa shettaman betokah haqqedera bemokin o bishar dabar sheeno mosip hebel — asur lehaamidah mibbeod yom al gabbe pesolet shel zetim, lepi shehem maalim hebel lemala behammokin, vehammokin mosipin hebel baqqedera hattemuna bahem, vahare hi kitmuna bedabar hammosip hebel. Abal muttar lehaamidah al gabbe pesolet shel shumshemin, shehem enam maalim hahebel lemala. Veken muttar lehaamidah betok hakkira shennitbashshela sham lehatminah sham bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, veap al pi sheshshule hakkira shehaqqedera omedet sham hem chammin meod, mikkol maqom kevan sheen chom hakkira mechamat atzmah ella mechamat haesh vekol shaa hi mitqareret veholeket — enah niqret dabar hammosip hebel, veeno domeh lipsolet shel zetim vekayyotze bahem shehem mosipim hebel meatzmam. Umikkol maqom, tzarik shettehe hakkira gerupa mehaggechalim, abal im yesh bah gechalim apillu hen qetumot — asur lehatmin bah haqqedera bibgadim o bishar dabar sheen mosip hebel, apillu im enah nogaat baggechalim kelal, kegon sheyyoshebet al gabbe kisse shel barzel, o shetteluya al gabbe abanim, lepi sheap shehabbegadim enan mosipim hebel mechamat atzman, mikkol maqom mechamat haggechalim shettachtehem shemmaalim hebel lemala — mosipim habbegadim hebel baqqedera, vahare hi temuna bedabar hammosip hebel. Veim hu beinyan sheen habbegadim nogeim baqqedera, kegon shennatan al haqqedera keli rachab sheeno nogea betzidde haqqedera venatan habbegadim al hakkeli, shennimtza sheen kan hatmana kelal apillu bedabar sheeno mosip hebel — hare zeh muttar, sheap shehaggechalim maalin hebel lemala — en bekak kelum, kevan sheen haqqedera temuna beshum dabar. Vehu shello tehe haqqedera nogaat baggechalim, abal im hi yoshebet al gabbe gechalim, ap im hi megulla legamre — yesh oserim, lepi shezzehu kematmin bedabar hammosip hebel, kevan sheap haqqedera nogaat baggechalim vehem maalim umosipim bah hebel. Veyesh omerim shekkol shehaqqedera megulla lemala — en zo hatmana. Veap im hi betok hattannur upi hattannur mekusseh — en bekak kelum, lepi shello aseru hatmana bedabar hammosip hebel ella mishshum gezera shemma yatmin beremetz, lepikak en leesor ella keen remetz, shehu dabar hammittaltel umudbaq ledopne haqqedera, abal dopne hattannur upiha enan mudbaqim lehaqqedera (veap im hattannur hu qatan vetzar — i epshar shello yihyeh avir qetzat mapsiq benehem). Veken hamminhag:

Vekol zeh keshehaggechalim hen qetumot, o shennitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom, o shennatan chatikat basar chayya biqdera samuk lachasheka mammash, sheim lo ken — ledibre hakkol asur ap belo shum hatmana, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g. Bemine batzeq ubemine qitniyyot shemmemaharim lehitbashshel — en moil kelum mah shehen chayyin samuk lachasheka (shemmemaharin lehitbashshel), kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"d:

Veim hattannur tuach betit sebib kissuyo — muttar bekol inyan ap behatmana mammash (betok haggechalim), sheaz en lachush lechittuy kemo shennitbaer sham. Velaken nohagim latuach pi hattannur betit. Ubimqomot sheen nohagim ken — tzarik shello yihyeh sham hatmana. Vetzarik sheyyitbashshelu haqqitniyyot umine batzeq mibbeod yom kemaakal ben derusai, o shehaggechalim yihyu qetumot:

Mitzva lehatmin leshabbat, kede sheyyokal chammin beshabbat, ki zehu mikkebod veoneg shabbat. Abal mi shehachammin mazziqin lo — muttar lo leekol tzonen. Abal mi sheeno maamin bedibre chakamim veoser akilat chammin beshabbat — chosheshin shemma eppiqoros hu:
